ai.summary: The FundraiseUp installation code was not found on https://www.care.org/. The page loaded (HTTP 200) in the headless browser. No installation code appeared in the page source, and no FundraiseUp widget request was recorded. The verdict is not installed, with the reason: installation code missing. The browser did not click any button, so it did not test whether the donate flow works. Links found: the page links to a Blackbaud Luminate Online donation form at my.care.org. That donation form returned HTTP 200 without JavaScript. Google Tag Manager (GTM-WMMPLB), GA4 (G-BE6GP7SC1M), and the Meta Pixel (312340198960624) were found and loaded. No known cookie consent tool was detected. The page load event was at 6.0 seconds. Five console errors were recorded.

customer_email.subject: Next steps for installing donations on care.org
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us on your online donation setup. We checked https://www.care.org/ and found that the donation installation code is not on the page yet.

Please do the following:

1. Add the installation code to the page source of https://www.care.org/. We will send the exact code separately.
2. Let us know which donation form you want visitors to use. The page currently links to a Blackbaud Luminate Online form.
3. If you have visitors in the EU or UK, consider adding a cookie consent tool.

Once the code is live, reply to this email and we will run the check again.

Thank you,
The Onboarding Team
